blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Functional segmentation requires locating small interactive parts, such as knobs, buttons, and sockets, in indoor point clouds and returning confidence-ranked instance masks. A point-wise semantic predictor produces a continuous probability field, whereas the benchmark evaluates a discrete set of scored instances. This creates a substantial field-to-instance gap. We present TopoField, a deterministic decoder built on top of VOLT. TopoField first converts 13 test-time forward passes into a semantic consensus field, then decodes instance candidates from the consensus geometry, and finally ranks the candidates in a class-aware manner. The augmentation stage retains the processed-point identity of every fragment prediction, accumulates probabilities in a common point array, normalizes by coverage count, and fuses the resulting caches. The decoding stage separates high-confidence cores from broader support regions, constructs a symmetric radius-pruned point graph, and uses a multi-source graph-geodesic partition to split support regions that contain multiple seeds. On 561 ground-truth instances across 30 validation scenes, an IoU-0.5-valid candidate exists for 67.2% of instances, and top-1 coverage is 20.0%. These complementary measurements motivate joint attention to candidate construction and ranking. TopoField achieves 28.286% AP, 41.383% AP50, and 47.558% AP25. TopoField achieved second place on the ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D Challenge.
blocks.zh: 功能分解需要在室内点云中定位小的交互部分,如接子、按钮和插座,并返回信任级实例口罩。 一个分点语义预测器产生连续概率字段,而基准则评价一组离散的得分实例. 这造成了实地对内部的巨大差距。 我们介绍托波·菲尔德(Topo Field),一个由VOLT上方所建的定型解码器. Topo Field首先将13个测试时间前行通道转换成语义共识领域,然后从共识几何中解码实例候选人,最后以有阶级意识的方式对候选人进行排序. 扩能阶段保留了每个片段预测的被处理分点身份,在共同分点阵列中积累概率,通过覆盖计数实现常态化并引信所形成的缓存. 解码阶段将高自信核心从更广泛的支持区域中分离出,构建出对称半径-普鲁士点图,并使用多源图形-geodesic分区来分化包含多种子的支持区域. 在561起涉及30个验证场景的地上真相案件中,67.2%的个案中存在一个IoU-0.5验证候选人,而顶级1的覆盖率为20.0%。 这些互补的衡量方法促使大家共同关注候选建筑和排名。 TopoField实现28.286%的AP,41.383%的AP50,47.558%的AP25. TopoField在ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D挑战赛上获得第二名.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: SceneFun3D [ 6 ] asks a model to locate nine categories of functional interaction elements, such as knobs, buttons, handles, and sockets, in complete indoor laser scans. Each prediction requires a category, a point mask, and a confidence score. These elements occupy only a small portion of their host objects, and adjacent elements can share material, color, and local geometry. The task therefore requires not only recognizing an interactable object, but also recovering the spatial extent of the part that affords an action. Related efforts emphasize fine-grained video understanding [ 10 ] , region-focused visual representations [ 5 ] , and entity-level alignment in composed retrieval [ 22 , 8 , 12 ] .
blocks.zh: SceneFun3D [6] 要求一个模型在完整的室内激光扫描中定位九类功能交互元素,如把手,按钮,手柄,和套座. 每个预测都需要一个类别,一个点罩,和一个信心分数. 这些元素只占据其宿主物体的一小部分,相邻元素可以共享材料,颜色,以及局部几何. 因此,这项任务不仅要求承认一个可相互作用的物体,而且要求恢复提供行动部分的空间范围。 相关努力强调精细的视频理解[10],以区域为重点的视觉表现[5],以及实体一级对编组检索[22、8、12]的调整。

blocks.en: Two coupled difficulties arise after a point-wise semantic predictor such as VOLT [ 41 ] . Small and partly occluded parts make per-point probabilities noisy: a high threshold truncates weak boundaries, whereas a low threshold can merge the target with its host or a neighbor. In addition, the predictor returns a continuous probability field, while the benchmark evaluates discrete masks sorted by confidence. Even with reasonable semantics, proposal construction and ordering can therefore cause a large field-to-instance error.
blocks.zh: 在像VOLT[41]这样的定点语义预测器之后,会出现两个附带的困难。 小型和部分被占用的部分使每个点的概率产生噪音:一个高阈值会分解弱边界,而低阈值可以将目标与其宿主或邻居合并. 此外,预测器还返回一个连续概率场,而基准则评价由置信度排序的离散罩. 因此,即使用合理的语义,建议书的构建和订购也可能造成大场对内错误.

blocks.en: We quantify this gap on 30 validation scenes containing 561 evaluable instances. The examined pool has an IoU-0.5-valid candidate for 67.2% of the instances, and top-1 coverage is 20.0%. These complementary statistics characterize candidate-pool coverage and the overlap achieved by top-ranked candidates.
blocks.zh: 我们在30个验证场景中量化这一差距,其中包含561个可评价实例。 接受检查的人才库有1名IoU-0.5合格候选人,占67.2%,最高一级为20.0%。 这些补充统计数据是候选人库覆盖面和排名最高的候选人所实现重叠的特点。

blocks.en: We present TopoField , whose method follows the two stages in Fig. 1 . Stage 1, TTA-based Semantic Consensus , applies the shared predictor to 13 test-time forward passes over 12 distinct rotation–scale outcomes. Each fragment retains a processed-point index that scatters its softmax output into a common point-by-class array; accumulated probabilities are divided by coverage count and the independent caches are renormalized and fused. Stage 2, Geometry-aware Instance Decoding , selects a class-specific operator from argmax connectivity, threshold-support connectivity, or a seeded graph basin. The basin branch separates high-confidence cores from broader supports, builds a symmetric radius-pruned 32-nearest-neighbor graph, and assigns support points to seed components by accumulated graph-path length. Candidates are then scored and suppressed class by class in the original scan point order.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍托波·菲尔德(Topo Field),他的方法遵循图1的两个阶段。第一阶段基于TTA语义共识(TTA)将共享预测器应用到13个测试时间前移,超过12个不同的轮值级结果。 每个片段保留一个经过处理的点指数,将其软马克斯输出分散到一个常见的点逐级阵列中;累积概率被覆盖计数除以,独立缓存被重新正常化和引信. 第2阶段,几何-认识实例解码(Geometry-aware Incentry Decoding ),从agmax连接,阈值支持连接中选择一个特定类操作员,或者一个种子图盆地. 流域分支将高自信核与更广泛的支持区分开来,构建对称半径的32-近邻图,并以累积的图路径长度为种子组件分配支持点. 考生再按原扫描点顺序按班次打分和压制.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. • We formulate the gap between point-wise semantics and the benchmark’s ranked instance-set output, and quantify it through complementary any-candidate and top- k k coverage statistics. • We organize the system as two explicit stages that mirror its implementation: index-aligned test-time semantic consensus and geometry-aware instance decoding. The first stage makes point identity and cache fusion explicit; the second exposes core selection, graph construction, geodesic seed assignment, and candidate ranking. • The parameter-free decoder achieves 28.286% AP, 41.383% AP 50 , and 47.558% AP 25 .
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下。 我们确定点位语义与基准的列位实例集产出之间的差距,并通过补充任何可选和顶端-k覆盖数据加以量化。 我们把该系统组织为反映其执行情况的两个明确阶段:指数对齐的测试时间语义共识和几何意识实例解码。 第一阶段明确了点身份和缓存聚变;第二阶段揭示了核心选择、图表构建、大地测量种子分配和候选排名。 无参数解码器实现28.286%AP,41.383%AP50,47.558%AP25.

blocks.en: We formulate the gap between point-wise semantics and the benchmark’s ranked instance-set output, and quantify it through complementary any-candidate and top- k k coverage statistics.
blocks.zh: 我们确定点位语义与基准的排序实例集产出之间的差距,并通过互补的任意描述和顶端K覆盖统计来量化它。

blocks.en: We organize the system as two explicit stages that mirror its implementation: index-aligned test-time semantic consensus and geometry-aware instance decoding. The first stage makes point identity and cache fusion explicit; the second exposes core selection, graph construction, geodesic seed assignment, and candidate ranking.
blocks.zh: 我们把该系统组织为反映其执行情况的两个明确阶段:指数对齐的测试时间语义共识和几何意识实例解码。 第一阶段使点身份和缓存核聚变明确;第二阶段暴露了核心选择,图表构造,大地测量种子分配,以及候选排名.

blocks.en: The parameter-free decoder achieves 28.286% AP, 41.383% AP 50 , and 47.558% AP 25 .
2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 3D instance segmentation. PointGroup [ 14 ] groups point-wise semantics with center offsets in two coordinate spaces, while SoftGroup [ 38 ] reduces hard-label error propagation with soft semantic grouping. Query-based methods such as Mask3D [ 29 ] and SPFormer [ 36 ] learn instance or superpoint queries and directly predict masks. These methods jointly learn representation, grouping, and refinement [ 2 , 15 ] . In visual tracking, complementary approaches explore window-based attention [ 35 ] , correlative masked modeling [ 32 ] , and query-gated feature selection [ 23 ] . TopoField converts a fixed semantic predictor’s output into a ranked instance set through deterministic grouping and confidence-based ranking.
blocks.zh: 3D 实例分割 。 PointGroup [14] 将中枢偏移在两个坐标空格中的点向语义组,而SoftGroup [38] 则用软语义组减少硬标签错误传播. 基于查询的方法,如Mask3D[29]和SPFormer[36]学习实例或超点查询,直接预测口罩. 这些方法共同学习代表性、分组和完善[2、15]。 在视觉跟踪中,互补方式探索基于窗口的注意[35],关联的蒙面模型[32],以及查询的特征选择[23]. Topo Field 通过确定性分组和基于信任的排名将固定语义预测器的输出转换为排序实例集.

blocks.en: Functional interaction element segmentation. SceneFun3D [ 6 ] extends indoor scene understanding from complete objects to functional parts such as handles, knobs, and buttons. These parts are small, often partly occluded, and geometrically similar to their neighbors [ 25 , 24 ] . Related work on composed video retrieval models shared and differential semantics [ 11 ] and calibrates directional anchors in composed representations [ 20 ] . VOLT [ 41 ] supplies the point-wise semantics in our system; TopoField constructs and ranks instance proposals from these semantic predictions. In video tracking, semantic consistency strengthens point correspondence [ 33 ] , while temporally coherent object flow supports multi-frame object association [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 功能相互作用元素分割. SceneFun3D [6]将室内场景理解从完整的物体延伸至功能部件,如手柄,把手,以及按钮. 这些部分很小,往往部分被占用,几何学上与邻居[25,24]相似. 有关编成的视频检索模型和差异语义[11]的相关工作,在编成的表达式中校准方向主锚[20]. VOLT[41]为我们系统中的点位语义提供; Topo Field构造并排序这些语义预测中的实例建议. 在视频跟踪中,语义一致性加强了点通信[33],而时间一致性对象流则支持多帧对象关联[31].

blocks.en: Graph-based region partitioning. Watershed-like methods propagate labels from seeds under a local adjacency structure [ 37 ] . A sparse point graph constrains propagation to 3D neighborhoods and prevents unreachable regions from borrowing labels across empty space [ 16 , 39 , 28 ] . Graph-structured relations also support heterogeneous nearest-neighbor retrieval [ 40 ] and collaborative motion reasoning in multi-object tracking [ 34 ] . TopoField applies this idea to a class-conditioned support: cores supply seeds, a radius-pruned symmetric kNN graph defines paths, and multi-source shortest paths assign support points to seeds. Connected components first isolate disconnected supports; geodesic propagation then handles connected supports with several cores.
blocks.zh: 基于图表的区域分割 。 类似流域的方法在当地附着结构下宣传种子的标签[37]。 一个稀疏的点图限制着向3D街区的传播,并阻止无法进入的地区在空地上借用标签[16,39,28]. 图形结构关系还支持在多对象跟踪中异形近邻检索[40]和协作运动推理[34]. TopoField将这个想法应用于一个类条件支持:核心提供种子,半径对称的kNN图定义路径,多源最短路径为种子分配支持点. 连接的组件首先隔离断开的支援;大地测量传播再处理与几个核心连接的支援.

blocks.en: Test-time augmentation. Test-time augmentation reduces variance by transforming the input and aggregating the corresponding outputs [ 1 , 9 , 26 , 30 ] . For per-point prediction, point identity must be preserved across augmentation and test-time voxelization. Stage 1 therefore scatters probabilities through retained point indices, normalizes by coverage, and fuses the caches before Stage 2 consumes the consensus field. Complementary evidence is also integrated through coupled multimodal state-space models [ 17 ] . Egocentric video understanding systems further explore category-conditioned inference and test-time consistency [ 4 ] , as well as capability-based reasoning routes [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh: 试验时间增强。 通过转换输入和汇总相应产出[1、9、26、30],试验时间的增加可减少差异。 对于每个点的预测,必须在整个增强和测试时间的氧化中保留点身份。 因此,第1阶段通过保留点指数分散概率,通过覆盖实现正常化,并在第2阶段消耗共识领域之前导出缓存。 还通过组合式的多国空间模型[17]整合了补充证据。 爱果中心视频理解系统进一步探索类别条件推论和测试时间一致性[4],以及基于能力的推理路径[18].

blocks.en: Noise-aware visual matching. Reliable visual matching depends on identifying task-relevant evidence and estimating the confidence of candidate associations. Research on noisy correspondence studies these issues in image–text retrieval, where training pairs can contain incorrect semantic associations. Huang et al. [ 13 ] introduce the Noisy Correspondence Rectifier, which partitions training pairs according to their estimated reliability and adaptively rectifies their correspondence through co-teaching. Qin et al. [ 27 ] develop an evidential learning framework that models correspondence uncertainty and adjusts negative-sample learning through a robust dynamic hinge loss. For composed image retrieval [ 19 ] , ConeSep [ 21 ] localizes noisy correspondences through geometric fidelity estimation and performs boundary-based targeted unlearning. Air-Know [ 7 ] integrates expert-prior arbitration with knowledge internalization to guide robust representation learning, while INTENT [ 3 ] combines visual invariant composition with discriminative learning to address cross-modal correspondence noise and modality-inherent interference. Together, these approaches highlight evidence selection and confidence estimation as central components of reliable matching. In TopoField, these considerations motivate the use of semantic consensus, confident core selection, and class-aware candidate scoring for constructing ranked instance predictions.
blocks.zh: 噪音意识视觉匹配. 可靠的视觉匹配取决于确定与任务相关的证据和估计候选协会的信心。 关于吵闹的通信的研究在图像文本检索中研究这些问题,其中培训对子可能包含不正确的语义关联. 黄等. [13]引入噪声函电校正器,按照预估的可靠性对培训对子进行分区,并通过协同教学来适应性地校正其函电. 秦等编. [27] 开发一个证据学习框架,通过强势动态链链式损失来模拟函证不确定性和调整负-样本学习. 对于构成的图像检索[19],ConeSep[21]通过几何忠诚度估计将吵闹的函文定位,并进行基于边界的定向不学习. Air-Know [7] 将专家优先仲裁与知识内化相结合,以指导稳健的表达式学习,而INTENT [3] 将视觉的不变量组成与歧视性学习相结合,以解决跨模式的函授噪声和模式内在干扰. 这些方法共同突出了证据选择和信心估计是可靠匹配的核心组成部分。 在Topo Field,这些考虑促使人们使用语义上的共识、自信的核心选择和有阶级意识的候选人得分来构建排名实例预测。

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1 : TopoField overview. Stage 1 aggregates index-aligned point probabilities from 13 test-time forward passes into a semantic consensus field. Stage 2 applies class-wise initialization, sparse-graph geodesic propagation, and candidate scoring.
blocks.zh: 图1:托波实地概况。 第一阶段 13个试验时间的指数对接点概率进入语义共识领域。 第2阶段采用分级初始化、零星大地测量学传播和候选评分。

blocks.en: TopoField is a deterministic decoder after a point-wise predictor. Stage 1 stabilizes the probability field and resolves index misalignment between augmented inputs; Stage 2 converts the field into instance masks and scores without updating predictor parameters.
blocks.zh: Topo Field 是一个定点解码器,经过一个点位的预测器. 第1阶段稳定了概率字段,解决了增量输入之间的指数错配; 第2阶段将字段转换成实例面具和分数,而不更新预测参数.

blocks.en: 3.4 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 3.4 执行细节

blocks.en: VOLT predicts at a 1 cm voxel resolution from XYZ, RGB, and normals. It has 12 transformer blocks, 768-dimensional embeddings, and 12 heads, initialized from ScanNet200 weights. Training uses AdamW ( 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , weight decay 0.05), label-smoothed cross-entropy, multiclass Lovász loss, and EMA (0.999). Test inference uses frozen probability caches without gradient updates. Unless stated otherwise, Stage 1 is fixed while Stage 2 is varied.
blocks.zh: VOLT预测从XYZ,RGB和正常的1厘米的Voxel分辨率. 它有12个变压器块,768维嵌入,以及12个头,从ScanNet200重量初始化. 训练使用AdamW(3×10−4 3\times 10×4}),重量衰减0.05,标签吸积的交叉性,多级Lovász损失,以及EMA(0.999)。 测试推论使用没有梯度更新的冻结概率缓存. 除非另有说明,第1阶段是固定的,第2阶段是变化的。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: SceneFun3D [ 6 ] contains 160 training, 30 validation, and 30 test scenes over nine categories. We train VOLT with XYZ, RGB, and normals at 1 cm. Stage 1 is used only at inference. The official metric is AP over IoU 0.50–0.95, with AP 50 and AP 25 also reported. R any R_{\mathrm{any}} is the fraction of ground-truth instances whose candidate pool contains an IoU-0.5-valid mask; R k R_{k} restricts this test to the class-wise top- k k candidates.

4.4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.4 讨论情况

blocks.en: Decoder components. The successive configurations in Table 2 increase development-split AP by 1.68 points with support/core selection, 0.71 points with graph geodesic partitioning, and 0.85 points with class-conditioned decoding. Together, these components raise full-validation AP from 36.58 to 39.67.
blocks.zh: 解码器组件. 表2中的相继配置增加了支持/核心选择的开发分解AP1.68分,图大地测量分解的0.71分,以及类条件解码的0.85分. 这些组件一起将完全验证AP从36.58提高到39.67.

blocks.en: Method behavior. The two stages perform complementary operations. Stage 1 aggregates index-aligned point predictions into a semantic consensus field. Stage 2 constructs and ranks instance masks using class-conditioned connectivity and graph-geodesic partitioning. Support/core selection retains boundary evidence and supplies confident seeds, while geodesic assignment partitions multi-core support regions according to their 3D connectivity.
blocks.zh: 方法行为. 这两个阶段开展辅助行动。 第1阶段将指数对应于点的预测汇总为一个语义共识领域. 第2阶段采用有类条件的连通和图地平面分割方式构建实例口罩并排位. 支助/核心选择保留了边界证据,并提供了自信种子,而大地测量任务则根据多核心支助区域的3D连通性进行分区。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented TopoField, a two-stage deterministic decoder for functional interaction element segmentation. Stage 1 turns multiple test-time forward passes into a stable semantic field by retaining processed-point indices, accumulating softmax probabilities in a common point array, normalizing repeated fragment contributions by coverage, and fusing independent caches. Stage 2 uses class-conditioned instance decoding; its seeded graph-basin branch separates a high-confidence core from a broader support region, constrains propagation with a symmetric radius-pruned point graph, and assigns support points to seed components by graph-geodesic distance. The validation analysis characterizes candidate coverage and ranking, and the combined decoder achieves 39.67% validation AP and 28.286% official-test AP. The decoder adds no learnable parameters to the point-wise predictor.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了Topo Field,用于功能相互作用元件分割的两级定理解码器。 第1阶段通过保留经处理的点指数、在共同点阵列中积累软马克思概率、使重复的碎片贡献通过覆盖实现正常化,以及使独立的缓存引信引信化,使多个测试时间向前移动变为稳定的语义领域。 第2阶段使用类条件的实例解码;其种子的图盆分支将高自信核与更广泛的支持区域分离,以对称半径-普鲁因点图限制传播,并以图盖距为种子组件指定支持点. 验证分析特征为候选覆盖和排名,合并解码器实现39.67%的验证AP和28.286%的官方测试AP. 解码器将任何可学习的参数添加到定点预测器中.
